title: Amazon is already offering new OpenAI products on AWS
summary: A day after OpenAI got Microsoft to agree to end exclusive rights, AWS announced a slate of OpenAI model offerings, including a new agent service.

title: Amazon launches an AI-powered audio Q&A experience on product pages
summary: Amazon's new "Join the chat" feature lets you ask questions about products and receive AI-powered audio responses.

title: Google expands Pentagon’s access to its AI after Anthropic’s refusal
summary: After Anthropic refused to allow the DoD to use its AI for domestic mass surveillance and autonomous weapons, Google has signed a new contract with the department.

title: Lovable launches its vibe-coding app on iOS and Android
summary: The app allows developers to vibe code web apps and websites on the go.

title: YouTube is testing an AI-powered search feature that shows guided answers
summary: YouTube is rolling out the new AI search feature to Premium subscribers in the U.S. on an opt-in basis.

title: BCI startup Neurable looks to license its ‘mind-reading’ tech for consumer wearables
summary: The startup specializes in "non-invasive" "mind-reading" tech — a kind of neural data collection that, its CEO hopes, will have all sorts of consumer applications.

title: Red Hat’s OpenClaw maintainer just made enterprise Claw deployments a lot safer
summary: Tank OS puts OpenClaw AI agents into a container that lets it run reliably and more safely, especially for those running fleets of them.

title: Otter’s new feature lets users search across their enterprise tools
summary: With this launch, users can connect their Gmail, Google Drive, Notion, Jira, and Salesforce accounts and query that data along with existing meeting data. The company said that it will soon allow connections with Microsoft Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and Slack.

title: OpenAI ends Microsoft legal peril over its $50B Amazon deal
summary: OpenAI has won major concessions from its largest shareholder, Microsoft, that will allow it to sell products on AWS, while Microsoft gets more cash in a revenue-share agreement.

title: DeepMind’s David Silver just raised $1.1B to build an AI that learns without human data
summary: Ineffable Intelligence, a British AI lab founded a mere few months ago by former DeepMind researcher David Silver, has raised $1.1 billion in funding at a valuation of $5.1 billion.

title: Investors back Skye’s AI home screen app for iPhone ahead of launch
summary: Skye's new AI app attracted investors before it even launched — a sign of interest in a more AI-aware iPhone.

title: China blocks Meta’s $2B Manus deal after months-long probe
summary: China has ordered Meta to unwind its multibillion-dollar Manus acquisition, dealing a potential setback to Zuckerberg’s push into AI agents.

title: OpenAI could be making a phone with AI agents replacing apps
summary: There have been plenty of rumors about OpenAI's hardware plans, which involve launching a pair of earbuds. A new note from industry analyst Ming-Chi Kuo suggests that the AI company might be working on a phone in collaboration with MediaTek, Qualcomm, and Luxshare.

title: Meta inks deal for solar power at night, beamed from space
summary: Overview Energy's first contract with Meta is a small step toward a future of space-based solar power.

title: To buy this Bay Area home, you’ll need Anthropic equity
summary: Someone’s offering an unusual deal for a 13-acre property in Mill Valley, just north of San Francisco.

title: Anthropic created a test marketplace for agent-on-agent commerce
summary: In a recent experiment, Anthropic created a classified marketplace where AI agents represented both buyers and sellers, striking real deals for real goods and real money.

title: Maine’s governor vetoes data center moratorium
summary: L.D. 307 would have imposed the country’s first statewide moratorium on new data centers — lasting, in this case, until November 1, 2027.

title: OpenAI CEO apologizes to Tumbler Ridge community
summary: In a letter to the residents of Tumbler Ridge, Canada, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said he is “deeply sorry” that his company failed to alert law enforcement about the suspect in a recent mass shooting.

title: Why Cohere is merging with Aleph Alpha
summary: Canadian AI startup Cohere is taking over Germany-based Aleph Alpha with support from Schwarz Group. With the blessing of their governments, the companies intend to offer a sovereign alternative to enterprises in an AI landscape dominated by American players.

title: Why Tokyo is the most important tech destination of 2026
summary: SusHi Tech Tokyo 2026 has four tightly defined technology domains, each backed by live demonstrations, dedicated exhibit floors, and sessions featuring the people actually building and funding these technologies globally.

title: Anan Data Center to provide 40MW AI infrastructure for Crusoe in Israel
summary: Contract has an estimated value of "hundreds of millions of dollars"

title: T-Mobile beefs up fiber push with two fresh joint ventures
summary: The carrier has plans to reach as many as 15 million premises with fiber by end of decade

title: Latitude.sh signs $25.1m three-year AI capacity agreement with unnamed customer
summary: Will see US-based technology company using Latitude.sh's compute and storage solutions

title: I Squared Capital acquires Brazilian data center firm Elea
summary: Terms not shared, joins likes of Kio, Exa, and nLighten under I Squared's ownership

title: Welsh data center proposal rejected by local council

title: Microsoft's Azure Local offering now scales up to 1,000s of servers
summary: Can now be a large-scale sovereign offering

title: Core Scientific secures 300MW capacity at Pecos data center in Texas, looks to behind-the-meter power
summary: First phase of HPC hosting capacity due live next year

title: Utah Planning Commission delays decision on Kevin O’Leary-backed data center project
summary: Up to 9GW project has already secured backing from Utah's Military Installation Development Authority

title: Boldyn Networks selected to provide 4G Emergency Services Network infrastructure across the London Underground
summary: The neutral host provider is already working with TfL to support 5G rollout across the Underground

title: Silicon photonics startup OpenLight raises additional $50m in extended Series A funding round
summary: Startup designs custom application-specific photonic chips

title: Csquare files S-1 form with SEC for planned IPO
summary: Cyxtera successor looks to go public

title: Google breaks ground on $15bn data center project in India
summary: Groundbreaking ceremony took place on April 28

title: Internet outages spike in Q1 2026, says Cloudflare
summary: Iran War largely to blame

title: Freshwave deploys 4G coverage across Leeds Bradford Airport
summary: 4G has take-off at the airport

title: ElectriGen to build and operate 1.8GW behind-the-meter gas platform for data center development in Texas
summary: Inks non-binding LOI to support construction of project

title: Oracle to deploy up to 2.45GW of Bloom fuel cells at New Mexico data center
summary: Will replace planned gas and diesel generators at site

title: Moov launches 5G network in Benin
summary: Becomes second carrier in the country to launch 5G

title: Edged tops out 42MW data center in Atlanta, Georgia
summary: Third building at campus due live next year

title: Virgin Media O2 signs 10-year solar PPA in Suffolk, UK
summary: Both companies owned by Liberty Global

title: Sponsored: Gerchamp launches new nickel-zinc battery: Balancing AI compute density and facility safety
summary: Eliminating thermal runaway risks and footprint constraints to empower high-performance AI workload scalability

title: TVA, Plus Power to deploy 200 MW/800 MWh BESS in Alabama
summary: Crawfish Creek would be one of the first grid-scale battery projects in TVA territory and a significant down payment toward its board-approved plan to deploy up to 1.5 GW of energy storage by 2029.

title: Industrial loads boost Consumers Energy’s sales as coal plant emergency order costs rise
summary: At least one analyst on Tuesday’s earnings call raised concerns about Consumers’ regulatory strategy after DTE Energy said it may pause future rate hike requests if its current request is approved.

title: Americans deserve facts, not fearmongering, about their electric bills
summary: Policymakers must remove barriers to new infrastructure and allow competitive power markets to function properly, writes Todd Snitchler, CEO of the Electric Power Supply Association.

title: 2 more offshore wind projects scrapped under Trump administration pressure
summary: The government said Bluepoint Wind and Golden State Wind have “agreed to voluntarily end their offshore wind leases.” EDP, a Portuguese company with stakes in both projects, said it has “agreed to settle imminent claims.”

title: Major critical infrastructure supplier reports cyberattack
summary: Itron, which claims to have contracts with more than 7,700 utility providers in 100 countries, said it “has not observed any subsequent unauthorized activity within its corporate systems” nor unauthorized access to customer data.

title: Extended heat wave could cripple New York’s grid this summer: NYISO
summary: Electric reliability margins will be “the lowest ... in recent history” at just 417 MW available under baseline summer conditions, the New York Independent System Operator said Friday.

title: Cities sue EPA for failing to uphold soot standard
summary: “By ignoring the legal responsibility to uphold its own rule, U.S. EPA is willfully abandoning the agency’s duties under the Clean Air Act,” California Air Resources Board Chair Lauren Sanchez said.

title: House Republicans introduce bill to extend renewables tax credits
summary: The American Energy Dominance Act would remove the accelerated deadlines that the One Big Beautiful Bill Act placed on the renewable energy 45Y production tax credit and 48E investment tax credit.

title: NextEra contracted 4 GW of new generation projects in Q1
summary: NextEra Energy Resources signed contracts for 1.3 GW of battery storage in the first quarter and expects to build 43 GW of battery storage by the end of 2032.

title: PJM market monitor opposes 1.3-GW gas plant deal between Hull Street, Rockland Capital
summary: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission should consider how power plant deals could draw capacity out of the PJM Interconnection market to serve data centers, Monitoring Analytics said.

title: Outer dome installed at Changjiang unit 4
summary: The outer steel dome has been installed at unit 4 of the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's Hainan province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

title: Rosatom 'ready to answer all Paks II questions'
summary: Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev has said they are ready to discuss any questions the incoming Hungarian government has about the Paks II nuclear power plant project.

title: Application lodged to build microreactor at US university
summary: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission announced it has received an application from the University of Illinois to construct the first research KRONOS micro modular reactor on the university's campus.

title: Bulgarian minister wants fixed price for Kozloduy 7 and 8
summary: Minister of Energy Traycho Traykov has said Bulgaria wants its proposed new nuclear power units at the Kozloduy plant to be built at fixed prices.

title: Dutch agreement paves way for construction of commercial MSR
summary: A memorandum of understanding has been signed for the construction of a non-nuclear demonstrator Thorizon molten-salt reactor in the Dutch province of Zeeland, a nuclear demonstrator at Petten, Noord-Holland, followed by the first commercial unit in Zeeland.

title: First Taipingling unit enters commercial operation
summary: Unit 1 of the Taipingling nuclear power plant has entered commercial operation, China General Nuclear announced. The unit is the first of six Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors planned for the site in Guangdong province.

title: OSGE and development agency sign agreement for Polish SMR project
summary: Poland's Orlen Synthos Green Energy has signed a letter of intent with the country's Industrial Development Agency to collaborate on the preparation for the construction and operation of small modular reactors at the Strategic Investment Park in Stalowa Wola.

title: Kairos breaks ground for Hermes 2 reactor
summary: The Hermes 2 Demonstration Plant in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, will be the company's first commercial-scale reactor and is the first power-producing Gen IV reactor to receive a construction permit from the US regulator.

title: First new Kursk unit 'ready for commercial operation'
summary: The first VVER-TOI unit at the Kursk II Nuclear Power Plant in Russia has successfully completed pilot operation and is ready for commercial operation, Rosatom says.

title: Grants allocated for Swedish feasibility studies
summary: The Swedish Environmental Protection Agency has distributed SEK19.8 million (USD2.2 million) to nine municipalities that have applied to carry out feasibility studies for new nuclear power.

title: Reactor vessel installed at third Zhangzhou unit
summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been installed at unit 3 of the Zhangzhou nuclear power plant in China's Fujian province, China National Nuclear Corporation announced. Zhangzhou 3 is the third of six HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site.

title: Korean financing to be considered for Vietnam projects
summary: The Export-Import Bank of Korea, Korea Trade Insurance Corporation, Korea Electric Power Corporation and Petrovietnam have agreed to explore possible South Korean financing of nuclear power projects in Vietnam.

title: TerraPower starts construction of 'first US utility-scale advanced nuclear plant'
summary: TerraPower has announced the official start of construction on its first Natrium plant, Kemmerer unit 1 in Wyoming. The Bill Gates-chaired company says the unit will be the first utility-scale advanced nuclear power plant in the United States.

title: US Air Force announces selections for microreactor deployments
summary: The US Department of the Air Force has selected Radiant Industries, Inc, Westinghouse Government Services and Antares Inc as potential microreactor developers and operators under its Advanced Nuclear Power for Installations initiative, as well as announcing a third potential location for a reactor.

title: Operating licence issued for Bangladesh's first nuclear power unit
summary: The inspection of primary equipment at Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant unit 1 has been completed, showing the unit in Bangladesh is now ready for first criticality, and an operating licence issued.

title: Inner dome installed at Shidaowan unit 1
summary: The inner safety dome has been installed on the containment building of unit 1 of the Shidaowan nuclear power plant site, China Huaneng announced. Shidaowan 1 is the first of four HPR1000 (Hualong One) units planned for the site in China's Shandong Province.

title: Stellaria, CEA to consider experimental MSR at Cadarache
summary: French molten salt reactor developer Stellaria has signed a letter of intent with the Alternative Energies & Atomic Energy Commission for a feasibility study for constructing its Alvin experimental reactor at its Cadarache site in southern France.

title: Czech SMR project - early works contract signed
summary: Czech nuclear operator ČEZ has signed an early works contract with Rolls-Royce SMR for the proposed construction of a small modular reactor at Temelín. ČEZ has also signed a memorandum of understanding with the Ministry of Industry and Trade to consider the investor model and possible sources of financing.

title: Hot tests completed at second San'ao unit
summary: Tests that simulate the temperatures and pressures which the reactor systems will be subjected to during normal operation have been completed at unit 2 of the San'ao nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province. The unit is the second of six HPR1000s (Hualong Ones) planned at the site.

title: Fuel loading begins for Bangladesh’s first nuclear power plant
summary: A ceremony has been held in Bangladesh to mark the start of the loading of 163 nuclear fuel assemblies into Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant’s first unit.
